## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and does not include unrelated work.
- [ ] Backend tests pass when Python code changed.
- [ ] Frontend lint, tests, and build pass when UI code changed.
- [ ] Rust formatting and checks pass when Tauri code changed.
- [ ] User-facing or developer documentation is updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private datasets, generated builds, or local model artifacts are committed.
